description: Get earnings call transcripts for a company. Returns paragraph-by-paragraph text (speaker, timestamp, text), paginated via paragraph_limit/paragraph_cursor since a full call can be tens of thousands of tokens.

fields.description: Comma-separated list of GraphQL field names to include; omitted = curated default set

lang.description: Target language for translated text fields (BCP 47, e.g. "ja", "zh-Hant"); English or omitted = no translation

limit.description: Maximum number of transcripts to return (default: all)

paragraph_cursor.description: Opaque continuation token from a previous response's paragraphs `pageInfo.endCursor`; omitted = first page

paragraph_limit.description:
Maximum transcript paragraphs per page; omitted = curated default (25). A
full call's `text` is returned as paginated paragraphs, not one giant blob

name: get_transcripts
title: Earnings Call Transcripts
